card.name: The word "for" after allow
card.fires_on: The word "for" right after "allow(s)/allowed", before a noun like adjustment, extension or communication. It also fires on a few unrelated name pieces, such as the end of Asaṅga and "hoc" in "ad hoc".

modes.label: allow for
modes.description: "for" directly following a form of "allow", introducing what becomes possible.
modes.example: It allowed<< for>> the extension of slavery, brought an end

modes.label: Partway through names
modes.description: A piece inside a foreign name or abbreviation, such as Asaṅga, ADHOC, or the phrase ad hoc.
modes.example: Vasubandhu 世親 and Asaṅ<<ga>> 無著 in such treatises
